source: Physical estimate: TCP is 320 mm behind reference tag ID 2
convention: T_reference_TCP maps points from the TCP frame into the reference-tag (ID 2) frame: p_ref = T_reference_TCP @ p_tcp. Translation is TCP origin in reference-tag frame, in metres.
tcp_definition: TCP axes are assumed aligned with reference marker ID 2; TCP origin is 320 mm along ID 2 -Z (the back side).
note: Physical estimate for live visualization. Validate the projected TCP origin and XYZ axes before relying on it for measurement or control.
